description: Exact security headers of every dashboard response and of the logo, shared by the Python and TypeScript shells. `withConnectSrc` is the CSP of the in-account shell, which adds the Hosted UI domain to connect-src.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

withConnectSrc.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://auth.example.com; img-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
